text: A man doesn't have to give me flowers, but he can if he wants to, and I will choose the one who wants to. A man doesn't have to buy me Chanel or Dior, but he can if he wants to, and I will choose the one who wants to. A man don't need to treat me like a princess, but he can if he wants to, and I will choose the one who wants to. Look, guys, there is nothing wrong with women wanting a man who is successful and financially stable. That's just a part of hypergamy, and it's fine. The problem with videos like this is that they promote a gold-digging or freeloading mentality. Women who watch them start believing that money is the only thing that matters in a man. Not respect, not loyalty, not empathy, not gratitude, not connection, just money and princess treatment. And they frame it like it's reasonable. He doesn't have to buy me anything, but he can if he wants to, and I will choose the one who wants to. That's like saying, you don't have to pay to hang out with me, but I'll only hang out with the ones who do. Guys, there's nothing wrong with spending money on a woman who genuinely deserves it, who likes you, treats you well, and gives back. But too many men throw money at women who only show up for that money. They think that they can earn affection and change the girls with their wallets. Well, maybe you will get some affection for some time, but her appetite will grow bigger and bigger, and you are not going to change her. A real connection isn't built on who spends the most. It's built on who actually wants you. If you constantly have to prove your value through gifts, she doesn't like you, she likes the treatment.
